headline: US Extends Suspension of Expanded Trade Blacklist Rule Ahead of Shenzhen Talks
summary: The US Bureau of Industry and Security extended the suspension of its 50 percent affiliate trade blacklist rule until January 10, ahead of upcoming bilateral trade talks.
why: Modifications or suspensions of trade restrictions and entity lists affect cross-border supply chains and trade negotiations between the US and China.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Extending the suspension of trade restrictions eases immediate regulatory friction ahead of bilateral talks.
